gotchas: Auto-choke: "The engine will automatically set the choke and begin the start sequence."
Stop is a fob button, not contact-open; no wired terminal exists on iGen models (only parallel ports, 507PC cable).
Unattended trap: "Remote start-equipped generators must be restarted with the START/STOP button on the control panel after an automatic shut-down occurs" (WGen9500DFc p.18).
Westinghouse's pairing bulletin claims "109 yards (100 meters)"; the manuals say 99 ft — contradiction, use the manual.
